job_description:

Address: SBC Module 15, -2 Floor, Thejaswini Building, Technopark Phase 1, Trivandrum, 695581 Website: http://www.reizendretail.in

Position: Test Automation Engineer – AI‑Assisted Testing & Implementation

Closing Date: 15 Oct 2026
Job Published: 31 Aug 2026
Contact Email: careers@reizend.ai
Location: Trivandrum (Work From Office)
Salary Package: 10 – 18 LPA

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Automation Test Engineer to design and implement testing practices that combine automation frameworks with AI‑powered testing tools, and to roll them out directly with engineering teams. The role includes hands‑on automation development, defining test strategies, standards, and workflows that keep AI‑assisted testing consistent and effective across projects. The position involves on‑site work with project and client teams as well as remote work, and requires understanding organizational context to adjust testing practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design the Testing Practice

  • Define test strategy templates, automation standards, and AI‑usage guidelines.
  • Evaluate AI‑powered testing tools and frameworks; recommend adoption per project/team.
  • Determine where AI tools are used (test generation, automation, defect analysis, reporting) and where manual review is required.

Build & Implement Automation

  • Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks and scripts for web, mobile, API, and integration testing.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, including automated quality gates and release validation.
  • Roll out testing practices directly with engineering teams and, when needed, at client locations.

Improve Through Feedback

  • Identify why a testing approach isn’t adopted and adjust based on root cause.
  • Capture lessons learned from each rollout and feed them back into shared standards.
  • Coordinate with development and deployment teams to ensure smooth testing integration in the delivery pipeline.

Required Skills

Automation & Quality Engineering

  • 3–6 years of hands‑on automation testing and quality engineering experience across web, mobile, API, and integration testing.
  • Strong experience with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Appium (or similar).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable automation frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of testing methodologies, test design techniques, and QA best practices.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of release validation, deployment testing, smoke testing, quality gates, and Git collaborative workflows.

AI Tools & Usage

  • Daily hands‑on experience with AI‑powered testing tools for test generation, automation development, defect analysis, and reporting.
  • Proficiency with more than one AI tool/model and ability to select the appropriate one.
  • Ability to craft clear prompts and correct AI‑generated outputs.
  • Active interest in emerging AI testing tools and techniques.

Communication

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret organizational and stakeholder context and explain testing strategies to technical and non‑technical audiences, including client‑facing settings.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience rolling out new testing practices/frameworks across multiple teams or clients.
  • Willingness to travel for on‑site implementation.
  • Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools.
  • Experience mentoring QA engineers.
  • Understanding of development and deployment pipeline structures.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience.

Apply now to join REIZEND and shape the future of AI‑assisted testing!
summary: Senior Automation Test Engineer leading AI‑assisted testing practice, building frameworks and guiding teams. Requires 3‑6 years automation experience with AI tools.
